meaning: Populate biological context compatibility from source-bound retained observations and domain/route meanings. Keep organism capability distinct from fixed-sample coverage; preserve physical unit bases, missing local mapping, unexamined states, sample weights, pairing and conditional sampling design. Logical domain bounds are not confidence intervals or intuitive quality grades. Purified-enzyme assays are not automatically organism witnesses or habitat samples. No target correspondence or annotation credit is calculated.
